purpose: Read-only episode-level reconciliation of the post-queue-mutation live/test explosion metric. This artifact records the exact numerator/status operations for a later atomic metric update; no metric, dashboard, queue, monitor-state, last-run, code, canonical baseline, Grafana, Netlify, or production deployment mutation was performed in this step.

metric_schema_and_representation.classification: test-only generated metric snapshot combining a separately frozen canonical audited baseline with post-baseline live monitor approvals; it is not the canonical historical baseline itself

meta.metric: strict confirmed public reports of explosions matched to production alert episodes
meta.rolling_rule: sum(strict matched alert episodes) / sum(all tracked alert episodes) over 90 completed calendar days; full windows only

metric_schema_and_representation.storage_shape: one aggregate object per city; there are no episode rows and no episode IDs inside explosions_test.json
metric_schema_and_representation.strict_representation: city.strict_n plus city.strict_daily[Kyiv-local alert-start date] and city.rolling90; unique approved_strict matched_episode_id values are added to the frozen baseline
metric_schema_and_representation.sensitivity_representation: city.sensitivity_n is a union count: every approved_strict or approved_sensitivity episode enters the sensitivity set; strict is therefore a subset of sensitivity
metric_schema_and_representation.city_representation: cities keyed by city_key with label in each city object
metric_schema_and_representation.episode_id_location: episode IDs live in explosion_candidate_monitor_state.json and matched_episode_id fields in explosion_review_queue.json, not in explosions_test.json
metric_schema_and_representation.alert_start_end_location: alert_start and alert_end are taken from monitor-state episodes
metric_schema_and_representation.metric_date_rule: episode date is alert_start converted to Europe/Kyiv; only episodes on or before each city's metric coverage_end can contribute
metric_schema_and_representation.source_status_location: candidate source/status live in the review queue; metric output stores aggregate counts, not per-source rows
metric_schema_and_representation.deduplication_key: matched_episode_id deduplicated in a Set inside each city; multiple approved candidates for one episode contribute at most one episode
